name: PT Pupuk Sriwidjaja Palembang (Pusri) ammonia-urea complex
description: Pioneer urea producer in Indonesia, established 24 Dec 1959, first production 1963 (Pusri-I), Pusri-II 1974; site 230 ha with Pusri-IB, Pusri-III, Pusri-IV and NPK units per EPD. EPD system boundary includes steam system, process condensate stripper, ARU & HRU and process condensate treatment. EPD PDF itself read (units/boundary); the 2.62 Mt/y figure is from a search snippet of a different Pusri PDF, page_read=false for that number.

capacities.basis: Capacity as stated on the cited page.
